title: finance/merchants
description: One row per business that accepts card payments. Where cardholders spend. Each merchant carries a real ISO 18245 Merchant Category Code, which is the standard every card network uses to classify what a business sells -- and what spending-analysis features categorise on.

name.description: Trading name in Spanish, built from the patterns real high-street businesses use. Entirely invented.

mcc.description: Merchant Category Code, a genuine four-digit ISO 18245 code. You can look any of them up and get the same description as the next column.

category.description: The official description of the MCC, stored alongside so a reader can interpret a transaction without a lookup table.

city.description: Spanish city the business trades in, so spending can be mapped geographically.

country.description: Country of the merchant. Most are Spanish, with a minority abroad -- which is what makes foreign transaction fees appear in the data.
